speechOptions.instruction: Calm, confident, measured — short declarative sentences, like a good product keynote. No exclamation marks in delivery, no salesy energy. Let the pauses between sentences breathe.

title: MulmoTerminal 4.7.3 — buttons that say they are working
description: Short feature clip (~15s) for MulmoTerminal 4.7.3. A worktree button that took six seconds and showed nothing got pressed again, making one worktree per click; it now locks itself and reports progress, and a cell being removed looks like it. Slides are English in both language versions — see busy-buttons-NOTES.md.

beats.text: Start a worktree, and the button locks itself and says what it is doing.
